reasons.plausibility: Shifting from screw- to edge-dominated plasticity via lattice distortion in BCC refractory HEAs is scientifically credible though it hinges on complex dislocation mechanics that need detailed validation.
reasons.testability: A controlled comparison of two specially prepared alloy variants with distinct levels of lattice distortion, coupled with mechanical testing and in situ dislocation analysis, provides a clear experimental path to potentially falsify this mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: Confirming the role of lattice distortion in stabilizing high-temperature strength and thermoelastic behavior is directly relevant for guiding the design of high-entropy refractory alloys.
